extraction_notes: Datasheet title covers the SS52 through SS520 family; SS54 is the SS52-SS56 group member with VRRM and VDC of 40 V.
Fig. 3 forward-voltage points were digitized from the solid SS52-SS54 typical curve at the plotted coordinates; the plot does not isolate SS54 from SS52 or SS53.
Fig. 4 reverse-characteristic points were digitized from the solid SS52-SS56 typical curve; the plot does not isolate SS54 from the other group members.
The electrical table also lists IR2 = 0.010 A at VR = VDC = 40 V and TA = 100 degC; the schema reverse_current field retains the 25 degC IR1 row.
No reverse-recovery time, breakdown voltage, or breakdown-current specification is published for SS54 in this datasheet.
